checklist_results.question: Does the deliverable serve one of G1-G7? Which KPI, exactly?
checklist_results.answer: Serves G2 Canonical Substrate Integrity: single canonical-bytes owner, real-run authorization, tape-canonical cost provenance, sandbox provenance, and owner-routed Python canonicalization.

checklist_results.question: Does it violate any red line in Intent section 5?
checklist_results.answer: No. M1.G roll-up uses existing evidence and a same-program ADDRESSED ceiling. It does not alter constitution bytes, claim external verification, use genesis/OG-10 signatures, enable M2, or declare closed/released/ratified/shipped status.

checklist_results.question: Is every claim backed by an artifact path an independent agent can open?
checklist_results.answer: Yes. The roll-up artifact lists ADRs, active repo commits, phase manifests/verifiers, real-run coverage, real provider receipt, refreshed tape bundle, strict audit artifacts, and tracker paths by absolute path and digest where applicable.

checklist_results.question: Is anything labeled real that is a fixture? Is anything unlabeled?
checklist_results.answer: The M1b and M1c real-run evidence roots are real worker runs with strict all-flags audit PASS. Historical/pre-M1c fixture or legacy evidence is not relabeled as real-provider receipt evidence.

checklist_results.question: Did scope grow beyond the Atom/Phase spec? If yes, cite the decision.
checklist_results.answer: No. This gate assembles the MODULE_M1 §3 artifact list, reruns §4 gate slices, rechecks child phase statuses, and asks for fresh verifier review. It does not perform M5.P4 external closure or FCE work.

checklist_results.question: Can the work be replayed or resumed by a fresh agent from tracker plus tape alone?
checklist_results.answer: Yes. The tracker M1 rows and M1G roll-up cite the repo SHA, exact audit commands, real tape bundles, receipt file, verifier artifacts, and session-state resume commands.

checklist_results.question: Does the status honor the ADDRESSED ceiling?
checklist_results.answer: Yes. This checklist supports only the implementer/program-internal ADDRESSED ceiling. Any EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED status for M1.G requires a later M5-class custody-separated ClosureCertificate artifact.
